## Verdict

**Dorado** costs least for a team of 18, at **$162 per month**. It is the only vendor on this list whose seat minimum (10) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly the 18 seats it uses. Inkwell bills for 25 seats and Borealis for 50, so both charge for capacity the team will not touch — Borealis nearly triples the billable headcount.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Dorado | $9 | 10 |
| Inkwell | $14 | 25 |
| Borealis | $19 | 50 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 18 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Dorado:** minimum 10 < 18, so 18 seats paid. 18 × $9 = **$162 per month**. Effective rate $9.00 per person.
- **Inkwell:** minimum 25 > 18, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $14 = **$350 per month**. Seven unused seats, worth $98. Effective rate $19.44 per person ($350 ÷ 18).
- **Borealis:** minimum 50 > 18, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $19 = **$950 per month**. Thirty-two unused seats, worth $608. Effective rate $52.78 per person ($950 ÷ 18).

Dorado is $188 per month cheaper than Inkwell and $788 per month cheaper than Borealis. Annualised, that is $2,256 and $9,456.

## Risks

Seat minimums, not per-seat rates, drive most of the gap here — but the ranking does not depend on them. Dorado has both the lowest rate and the lowest minimum, so it stays cheapest at every headcount on this list: at 25 seats it costs $225 against Inkwell's $350, and at 50 seats $450 against Borealis's $950. Growth narrows the relative gap but does not reverse it.

A shrinking team changes little: below 10 people Dorado bills its $90 floor, which still undercuts both alternatives.

This comparison covers list price only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security posture, or integrations, so a cheaper seat may buy less product — that gap is unmeasured here.

All figures assume monthly billing at list price, as stated. Annual commitments, negotiated discounts, onboarding fees, and migration costs are not in the source and could change these totals.
